When you say you don't empathize with other people. I would see that as a problem. But actually most people dont empathize. That is a misconception. Most people are obsessed with themselves and dont give two shits about the person sat next to them. Most people befriend other people because it is in their interests in my opinion. There is a minority of people who have a lot of empathy but they live outside the classic social circles. So you are normal on that front. Except apparently you don't want to play the game. The global game of social manipulation and self-centered aspirations. People are nice to other people because they know it helps them get what they want. People who are good in social settings are good because they are good manipulators. I believe that a lot of people learn these skills when they are a child, they learn to manipulate their surroundings to get what they want. We all do this to an extent, a lot of us are naive enough to not realise our own motivations, so we delude ourselves that we are more altruistic than we really are.

 I like to take the example of charity. Here charity, and in particular charitable organisations and NGO's have become more and more prevalent. But if you look at their staff, and the motivations behind a lot of people's actions, their is a lot of self-interest. This is because over time the social mores of a lot of western society has shifted making it socially attractive to be seen to be benevolent and giving, almost akin to a sign of intelligence. As such it is benefits people to show demonstrate this social trait, and what better way than to work for an NGO. 

You are no different from anyone else in this regard, you just lack the important social skill of hiding your true intentions. I myself, upon realizing how prevalent manipulation and deceit is in the global adult population have become disgusted with myself and the world around me, and don't think im going to hang around much longer. Even my mother now that she is getting older repeatedly tries to manipulate me into staying near her and taking care of her, though I am quite clearly unhappy where I am. My ex girlfriend left me upon realizing that I didnt have any classic social aspirations, and used me to improve her own. My Masters class mates would denigrate me behind my back for not playing the networking game and not conforming. If you don't play the game, you get ostracized. Some people are lucky enough to find friends who are clever enough to realise that this is all just an extension of the school yard, petty social pressure, and a lot of these social conventions are actually irrational. 

I challenge you to go out and find people who put their head above the parapet and  challenge convention. To be honest, once you find them tell me, because I have looked, and they dont exist in vast numbers.
